reviews.comment: I loved this prof because he just is so amazing at explaining things and will answer any questions! Super nice and even let me take my final exam after I was done being sick!

Professor Steven is great and not overly demanding. He understands that this class is required but still does a great job teaching in an interesting manner. Canvas makes it easy to follow along outside of class so attendance is definitely not required. The tests are super easy if you just study the study guides.

stevens understands that most people are only taking his class because it is mandatory so he makes it very clear and easy. Everything is on the power points. there are weekly quizzes and packbacks, with the opportunity to skip on of each.

This class is very easy as long as you just do the work that is expected. It's not hard at all to pass, and he does a good job during lectures, and makes everything easily understandable. He's a great professor and respects student's overall, so I would recommend taking his class.

Dr. Stevens has made the class very easy and enjoyable to take. He is also very sweet and caring. There was no final and he made sure to make the exam content explicitly stated in his lectures. Make sure to do his weekly packbacks, but they are not that bad. While, he reads from the textbook, his lectures are still nice to go and listen to.

Lecture material is easily accessible and easy to read. Exams are straightforward and should not be difficult if properly prepared and studied for. There's no final exam, which alleviates a LOT of pressure during finals week. Just ensure that you remember to do the weekly Packbacks and Chapter Quizzes.

Dr. Stevens is amazing! I loved going to his class even though attendance wasn't mandatory. He makes lectures interesting and pretty straightforward. The exams are somewhat detailed, but if you go to class you should be fine. Really great guy, you will not regret taking him!

Professor Stevens is AMAZING !! He explains concepts very well and only includes pertinent information in his lectures, which are also worth attending (though not mandatory). There are quizzes each chapter, but they aren't bad. Packbacks are due every Sunday. Total of 3 multiple choice exams. Textbook not needed, but helpful.

Prof Stevens is great! His class is very straight forward and his lectures are easy to follow along. He highlights information in his slides that will be on the test. Make sure to go to his exam review class, because he goes over everything on the test/test review sheet. The tests will be completely from the review sheet.

Stevens was an amazing prof! The grade is mostly based on the weekly pack back (easy 100s) and exams. The exams are super easy as long as you study his lecture slides and do the exam review sheet. All of the necessary content is on his slides.

Professor Stevens is the BEST for POLS207! I highly recommend. Class is clearly structured. You are graded by discussion posts, quizzes, and exams. Quizzes are open note (takes abt 2 min), exams have test reviews (do them and you will never get below a 90), discussion posts are insightful to the class. Attendance is not mandatory.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Best POLS207 professor at this university by far. Attendance is not mandatory and he posts his lecture slides on canvas. He posts a study guide prior to the tests and the tests are extremely straight forward. Study for the tests and you will get an easy A. He is also very caring and cracks jokes during class.

Dr. Stevens was a wonderful professor. Attendance isn't really necessary as he bolds what is important in lecture slides. As long as you show up to review day, you are guaranteed an A in all three exams. He is a very caring and kind professor. There are weekly packbacks and chapter quizzes which are short and don't count for much.

Professor Stevens did a great job of keeping the class engaged and cracked jokes too. He is very kind and if you have any kind of issue, he is willing to find a solution. The tests are fair as long as you study the guides given. There are weekly quizzes and packbacks to help you analyze the material. Overall, an amazing professor. TAKE HIM!

The course is very well-built and straight to the point. The exams are also formatted with topics directly from the reviews that he will provide. He is also very caring and willing to help. Take his class!
You must study the lecture slides, everything bolded and underlined. He gives a review sheet of everything that will be on the exam so study it. You study, you will make an A!

Professor Stevens is such an amazing professor! Only assignments are one chapter quiz and Packback post a week, a few easy assignments, and exams are easy if you study his study guides! Exams do make up a huge portion of the overall grades though. But, he has a review day in class prior to exams and goes over the entire review. He is awesome!

Professor Stevens is AWESOME!!! He made the class simple and as easy as a POLS class can be!! There are weekly quizzes that are open notes, a pack back due once a week, and three tests that he provides reviews for and goes over in class.  The tests are fairly easy if you study and the questions are straightforward. Highly recommend!!

Reed Stevens is the BOMB. Super easy class if you do you work and go to test reviews. He is super nice but I do suggest still going to class to get info and not feel behind He posts everything on canvas and quizzes, tests and assignments are not that hard.

Stevens is a super sweet professor. He just recently graduated and still understands what it is like to be a student. He keeps homework light a do-able. The exams are straight forward, and he provides a useful study guide. He suggests a textbook, but you don't have to read it because all of the concepts are on the slides that he posts to canvas.

Literally the GOAT. Class has a very clear structure, provides review sheets before exams, and drops quite a few assignments. Makes lectures about boring topics more interesting and gives you many chances to succeed. Definitely take him for this class.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: He makes lectures as interesting as he can when talking about government. There are weekly packsack and quizzes which are super easy. You definitely have to study for his exams, but he gives a review before each one.

Absolutely awesome prof! You definitely need to study for his tests, but they are very straight forward and maybe take 20 minutes if you study. Study guides are VERY helpful. 2 very easy projects, and packbacks every week. Attendance is not madadtory.

Professor Stevens is one of the nicest profs at A&M. He genuinely cares about his students and wants them to succeed. He gives you a study guide before each exam which helped a lot. Exams themselves aren't hard either. Highly recommend!!
He is great professor who really cares about his students but his exams were very difficult which was my downfall.

Professor Stevens is a cool guy and he structured his class very clearly. His lectures were straight from the textbook and his exams could be a little nit picky on very specific pieces of information but the class was overall an easy A! Great guy and would definitely take again!

Organized professor, all slides are posted on canvas. Quizzes are done on canvas outside of class and are open note. There's almost no homework for this class and the tests come verbatim from the study guide. Didn't go to most of the classes and got a high A.
Very cool guy, interesting lectures. Easy class, kind prof.

Best 207 prof here! Attendance isn't mandatory, just do the test reviews because he literally spells out what's on the test. The assignments were very simple and he genuinely cares about his students. I skipped class a lot and it wasn't hard to catch up since all slides are posted on canvas.
TAKE HIM!!! Extremely easy course and very laid back. Do the test reviews before the exam and you will be good to go.

TAKE HIM!!! Extremely easy course and very laid back. Do the test reviews before the exam and you will be good to go. I did not even go to class and finished with high A (because I did the exam reviews).

Probably the easiest college class I'll ever take. I wouldn't go to class and would just do the test reviews and assignments on canvas. I finished with a high A and there aren't too many weekly assignments except 5 question quizzes and packbacks. Take him for 207.

You have quizzes, packback discussions, 2 assignments, and 3 tests. Quizzes are open notes and easy. Packback and assignments easy too, just keep up with it every week. The exams are little difficult, however he gives a review sheet of what to study. Final exam is not comprehensive. He is chill and showed us a documentary about his dad in class.

Great prof! His lectures are pretty helpful and if you miss class it's not hard to catch up. There's little assignments and the quizzes are very easy. He provides a test review for every exam, and as long as you do the test review its easy to do good on the test.

Professor Stevens was one of my favorite profs this year! He is a great lecturer and will go in depth on topics if students express uncertainty. I missed his class a few times but it was easy to catch up by going through slides and reading the textbook. He is a very kind teacher and genuinely cares about his students, and he drops lowest grades.

A&M needs more profs like Dr. Stevens! He is a first-year prof so he can relate to students a lot easier than most profs. His course and assignments, tests, projects are straightforward and easy to do well on. If you put the effort in, you will get the grade! No extraneous homework, or projects. He has one of the easiest lectures to sit through!
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: One quiz and one packback a week, exams are easy if you study the review he sends out the week before, projects are easy as well.

(I was in his regular POLS 207 class for fall 2022, but spring 2023 he is only teaching honors POLS 207) 
You don't need to buy the book. Everything covered in the book will be covered in his lectures. You also don't need to come to class - every lecture is posted in Canvas. For the exam, memorize vocab, numbers, and bolded concepts in his lectures

Amazing prof. Posts all his materials online so you definitely do not have to attend, but I would recommend it. He's funny and very good at answering students' questions. 

Very easy assignments/homework and does review for all his exams so it's difficult to not do well on them. Didn't read the textbook once and got 95%+ on all exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: This year was his first year teaching and he did an amazing job. His lectures give you all the information you need and his review the class before the test is very beneficial, go to them! It is very easy to get an A in his class and all the assignments do not take too much time and he gives you a review sheet for everything that is on the exam.

100% the best prof I had this semester. You can tell he is passionate about teaching and he really wants students to succeed. He doesn't offer extra credit so don't rely on that, but exams are thoroughly reviewed and getting an A is not difficult at all. Very easy homework with weekly quizzes and packbacks, but he drops lowest grades. Love him!

Best professor ever. His class is all lecture, there are never any pop quizzes or anything you can't study for. He gives study guides and has in class review sessions. All of his assignments are short and to the point. I would suggest this prof for pols207 100%.

Professor Stevens was great! His class was set up where if you didn't go, you could still succeed. I went to almost every lecture. There was a textbook, but each portion of it was thoroughly covered in the lecture and the slides. I would definitely take him again! He wants his students to succeed!

Best professor i've had at a&m. super sweet guy and actually cares about his students. Gives test reviews literally word for word the test and quizzes are straight from the notes. Other assignments are completion grades. Very easy class if you put in the work and go to the review days right before the test. TAKE HIM!

I LOVED HIM! I found his lectures to be super interesting. There's only three exams and no final, exams weren't hard as long as you do the review, memorize the answers, and stay for his in class reviews (gives you answers!) All his assignments were easy, SO MAKE SURE TO DO THEM. I never read the textbook in this class and did great. Go to lecture!
He made the class super easy. Only the stuff on the review sheet was on the test and all his assignments were basically completion grades. He is also a good lecturer. Totally recommend taking him.

A quiz after every lecture and a Packback is due every week outside of class but will take no more than 30 minutes of your time. He also makes tests exactly like the reviews, so as long as you just do your work on time and study the review sheets he makes, it's an easy A.

TAKE THIS CLASS FOR POLS207!! Dr. Stevens is a very kind and straightforward professor and his workload was the lightest I've had all semester. There is a weekly packback assignment which is a guaranteed 100 if you just write - and the weekly quizzes were open note and taken at home. Easy exams also - study the study guide. Awesome Professor!

Easily one of my favorite professors! I recommend him to anybody who wants an A in their pols course. There are weekly quizzes and packbacks, but the quizzes are only 5 questions long and the packbacks have an easy grading criteria. Before the exam he does a review day and gives you the exact answers you need to know for the exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He is absolutely amazing.

His lectures covered everything that was on the tests and all the important things were highlighted. He leaves his power points on Canvas to review, and is very good at answering questions through emails and office hours. Extremely helpful study guides. This was his first semester teaching, and I am very appreciative of him and his hard work.

Professor Stevens is a great professor. Everything you will be tested on will be available through study sheets and online PowerPoint to you. His lectures are very entertaining as he is a bit quirky but very passionate and explains everything in great detail. As a freshman, this was easily one of my favorite and easiest classes.

Professor Stevens was awesome! He made pols 207 very interesting and clearly cared about his students! Great at explaining topics in an easy way to understand. I would recommend him to any incoming students who have to take pols 207!

Dr. Stevens was a great professor! Attendance isn't mandatory, but highly recommended as he will often point out the important points that will be on the test. His test review guides are very well organized and his review sessions are great! He also gives multiple reminders for due dates on assignments and quizzes. Couldn't recommend him more!

Dr. Stevens was such a good professor. Class was not mandatory and there was weekly quizzes that were easy. There are packbacks also. He gives reviews for the exams that are easy to understand and go over. The exams are not hard as long as you study. I really recommend Stevens.

Really nice guy. He'll make several reminders for when assignments are due. Going to lecture isn't necessary, but it helps when it comes to taking the exams. He makes very helpful study guides. Take Stevens if you don't want to have to worry about a required course. There are 3 exams and no final.

Dr. Stevens understands that pols 207 is a required course that most students are just trying to get through, and he does everything he can to help students succeed. I barely read the textbook, just pay attention in lectures or take notes on the slides and quizzes should be easy. Go to the classes before exams, his review sessions are very helpful.

Professor Stevens is very laidback and wants all his students to succeed, he teaches pretty much what the textbook is so if you want to do well just follow the slides and write anything he emphasizes. He even has a review before the tests which is very helpful. He is a funny guy, teaches well, and wants you to succeed.

Overall a chill & straightforward professor. The workload was easy with one Packback and quiz a week. Presentations cover almost all of the exam material, and exams are easy except some questions can be weirdly specific. He's nice and helps explain the material without making it too difficult. Definitely would take 207 with him again.

This class was very structured and easy to work with. His class typically consists of lectures on powerpoints he gives in class, which are avaliable online, so attendance isn't mandatory at all, a nice touch. I highly recommend him as your professor for this class.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: His tests are super easy but can be tricky if you don't study the notes which can be easily written through his power points. There are weekly packbacks and quizzes which are 5 questions. Highly recommend him for pols 207 (if he's still teaching) he's literally better than the other professors!

By far one of my favorite professors, he made what should be a hard and boring class , into a easy, stress free class. A quiz and a packback a week. Tests are super easy and come straight from the notes. He understands most people are taking pols by requirement and cares about his students. Would 100% take again.

He's a pretty straightforward lecturer, either go to class or read the textbook. Quizzes are easy if you went to class, they have some details that he points out in lecture that aren't emphasized as much in the book. Totally chill professor, he gets that most of us are only taking the class because its required by state.

He taught straight from the textbook: either you don't have to go to class, and you just read, or you don't need to get the textbook and just go to class. The quizzes are super easy if you paid attention and there's hardly any homework to worry about.

Professor Stevens is such a great professor. His class is really easy as long as you study. His lectures are very boring but he post all of the slides from the lectures online. Weekly packback and chapter quizzes but the quizzes are really easy. There are 3 test and no final and he posts a review for each test that are really helpful.

I went out of my way to write this review bc genuinely love Dr.Stevens. He has made the class structured so you don't have to spend time outside class. He makes it clear on what he is going to test. Very nice with good persona. Would encourage everyone to take him. 11/10 professor

Dr. Stevens is an amazing professor. His lectures are concise and he gives good examples to make sure everyone understands. Reading the textbook would help but going to class is sufficient. He is really kind and the class only required an hour of outside work weekly. Test reviews are really helpful. Put in the effort and be nice to him!!

Lectures aren't required, but drops hints on exam topics which are taken from lecture slides. Little work outside of class other than discussion boards and chapter quizzes. Textbook not required as he explains them in lecture. Provides review sheets for exams which are helpful. Overall, an amazing professor who is passionate about the subject.

Dr.Stevens lectures are amazing. You technically are not required to even attend his lectures and its good if you could. You barely have to study after a lecture. You basically have to study and memorize that for the exam and you are ready for the exam from test review he posts. Exams are easy. Quizzez are also very easy. He explains really well.

- Boring lectures
- Packback required
- drops quizzes and assignments
- gives test review 
-easy test if u use the review 
- very sweet and new prof

Definitely take this class if you can. He is very chill and easygoing, drops low grades, and is extremely knowledgeable. He repeats important points and underlines them in his lecture slides. He genuinely cares about the students and deserves respect from them in return. By far my favorite class and professor of my first semester.
This guy is chill. Take his class and be nice to him

I had Professor Stevens for both POLS 200 & 455. He is by far the best POLS professor in the department. He genuinely cares about his students and wants for them to succeed, which is evident since he allows students to revise essays to get a higher grade. He is able to make difficult concepts understandable. Definitely take his class if you can!

Professor Stevens makes would could be a very difficult class manageable. You have a reflection every week over these readings but if you take notes you honestly don't need to read. You have three essays but can make half points back on the first two. Attendance is a big part of your grade. He sometimes makes his questions harder than he needs to.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Prof Stevens is by far the best POLS prof. He has interesting lectures and has quick weekly reflections and 3 bigger essays (4 pages each). You can make corrections and receive points back. He is a great professor and genuine guy. I always look forward to his lectures.
